Card Q&A.a: Yes. Since it meets the activation conditions, they all activate.
Card Q&A.q: If the DP of an opponent's Digimon is reduced to 0 and deleted, if I have multiple Digimon with this Digimon as digivolution cards, do all of their effects activate?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted by dropping to 0 DP, gain 1 memory.
